item.title: Tiny fossils show brittle stars gathered around a dead whale 9.5 million years ago
item.description: [Open Source Software] Keyword: FOSS — Tiny skeletal plates recovered beside fossil whale bones in southern Denmark offer a rare glimpse of life around a whale carcass approximately 9.5 million years ago. Researchers have identified a new species of brittle star, Ophiura huebnerjenseni, from the Gram Clay Pit and suggest it represents the first fossil record of brittle stars associated with a whale fall.
